title: 川崎記念の後に・ぎゅるるん！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon scores a fantastic victory at the Kawasaki Kinen, displaying an overwhelming speed no one else could keep up with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She can feel her own strength, and gains confidence that she can run internationally one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I invite Smart Falcon out to celebrate her victory, but she declines the offer so she can notch up more victories.
